Class Tribe

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.player.Tribe
public class Tribe extends Object
Stores the cards collected by a player and computes tribe-dependent bonuses.

The tribe aggregate groups all character and building cards acquired during the match. It exposes convenience queries used by event resolution and final scoring to count specific card types, detect protection effects, and compute derived rewards based on the owned buildings.

    • Tribe

      public Tribe()
      Creates an empty tribe with no characters or buildings.

    • Tribe

      public Tribe(List<CharacterCard> characters, List<BuildingCard> buildings)
      Creates a tribe with an explicit initial owned card collection.

      This constructor is used when a caller already has the complete tribe state and must rebuild it without re-triggering draw-time side effects.

      Parameters:
      characters - initial character cards
      buildings - initial building cards
